write_audio_file: write audio data from a torch tensor or numpy array to a wav or flac file at a given sample rate
read_audio_file: read audio from a wav or flac file and resample it to a target sample rate
remove_none_values_from_dict: remove None-value entries from a nested configuration dictionary and return an OmegaConf object
die_if_condition_met: print an error message and immediately exit the process if a condition evaluates to true
hard_exit_process: flush stdout and stderr then exit the process immediately with a given exit code
